Contributions to GEOINFORMATIK 2012

Our Computer Graphics Systems working group at the Hasso-Plattner-Institut is contributing two papers and presentations to the GEOINFORMATIK 2012, which will be held in Braunschweig, on March 28-30, 2012. Mobility and environment are the two major topics of this year's conference.

The first contribution is a paper on "Dichte- und Distanzanalyse massiver raumzeitlicher Bewegungsdaten" by Stefan Buschmann and Jürgen Döllner. A second paper is about "Potentiale von massiven 3D-Punktwolkendatenströmen" by Rico Richter and Jürgen Döllner.

Link to the conference and program.
